note: Authored. Advice questions: the answer must open with one pick, one reason and a choose-the-other-if.

cases.question: Should Testbard take Mining or Herbalism alongside Skinning?
Is it better to spend my first 60 gold on the mount or on bags?

reference.text: The basic mount costs 60 gold at level 40. Tailoring makes bags of up to 16 slots.

cases.question: Which should Examplemage level first, Frost or Fire?
Do we do the Sunken Vault tonight or the Ember Rite chain?

reference.text: The Sunken Vault is a five-player dungeon for levels 28 to 34. The Ember Rite attunement has 9 quests and takes about 3 hours.

cases.question: Cloth or leather for a pure healer at this level?
Should I buy dual spec as soon as it unlocks?

reference.text: Dual spec unlocks at level 40 and costs 10 gold.

cases.question: What is the best use of one evening: gold farming or leveling?
Should my healer take Mending Aura or Spirit Boon at level 30?

reference.text: Pick Mending Aura for steady group healing. Choose Spirit Boon if you mostly solo and need mana back.

cases.question: Should I buy the mount first or a bigger bag?

reference.text: Buy the mount first: it costs 60 gold at level 40. Choose the bag if you are under level 40 and your bags are full.

cases.question: Which first profession pairs best with Alchemy?

reference.text: Pick Herbalism, since Alchemy consumes herbs. Choose Mining if you plan to sell metal bars instead.

cases.question: Should we run the Sunken Vault at level 30 or wait until 32?

reference.text: Go at level 30: the dungeon is tuned for levels 28 to 34. Wait until 32 if your healer is under-geared.

cases.question: Two-hand weapon or one-hand and shield for a frontliner at level 35?

reference.text: Pick one-hand and shield for survival. Choose the two-hand weapon if the group has a second frontliner.

cases.question: Should I join a guild now or wait until I reach the level cap?
At level 40, do I buy dual spec or the mount first?

reference.text: Buy the mount first at 60 gold. Dual spec costs only 10 gold, so buy it second. Choose dual spec first if your group needs a second role this week.

cases.question: Should Fakerogue use the bow or the crossbow?

reference.text: Pick the bow for its 40 yard range. Choose the crossbow if you mostly fight at close range.

cases.question: Which trinket first: Ember Charm or Frost Sigil?

reference.text: Pick Ember Charm, which adds 12 damage. Choose Frost Sigil if your spec is frost.

cases.question: Tailoring or Enchanting for a cloth wearer?

reference.text: Pick Tailoring, because it makes the bags and the cloth gear. Choose Enchanting if you already have a bag supply from a friend.

cases.question: Should I keep leveling around Cinder Post or move to Saltmere at level 35?

reference.text: Move to Saltmere at level 35. Stay at Cinder Post if you still have the Ember Rite chain to finish.

cases.question: Do I spend tonight on the Ember Rite chain or the Thornfall chain?

reference.text: Pick the Ember Rite chain: 9 quests and about 3 hours. Choose Thornfall if you want its ring and have more than 14 quests of time.

cases.question: Should the guild buy its first bank tab now?

reference.text: Buy the first tab now at 100 gold. Wait if the guild has fewer than 5 active members.

cases.question: Bandages or potions for the Sunken Vault?

reference.text: Pick bandages: they cost less and work between pulls. Choose potions if you expect a pull where nobody can stand still.
